functions.name: converter
functions.description: Converts a specified amount from a source currency to one or more target currencies. Returns converted values using current exchange rates. Useful for financial calculations and multi-currency transactions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

target.description: Comma-separated list of target currency codes (e.g., 'EUR,GBP,JPY'). Each must be a valid ISO 4217 three-letter currency code.

source.description: Source currency code (e.g., 'USD'). Must be a valid ISO 4217 three-letter currency code.

amount.description: The amount to convert from the source currency. If not specified, defaults to 1.

date.description: Date for which to retrieve match data in DD/MM/YYYY format. Must be within 7 days before or after the current date.

functions.name: usd_egp
functions.description: Converts US Dollars (USD) to Egyptian Pounds (EGP) using current exchange rate data. Provides real-time conversion amounts and exchange rate information for financial calculations and business transactions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

amount.description: Positive numeric value representing the USD amount to convert to EGP. Must be greater than 0.

date.description: Date string in YYYY-MM-DD format for historical exchange rate lookup. Defaults to current date if not specified.

decimal_places.description: Number of decimal places to format the converted EGP amount. Valid values: 0-6. Default is 2.

functions.name: retorna_os_registros_dos_ltimos_dias
functions.description: Retrieves historical exchange rate records for a specified currency pair over a defined number of recent days. Returns data in the requested response format (JSON, JSONP, or XML). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

format.description: Response format type. Valid values: json, jsonp, xml

numero_dias.description: Number of recent days to return records for. Must be a numeric string. Default: '30' if not specified

moeda.description: Currency pair in {source}-{target} format (e.g., USD-BRL, EUR-BRL). Must be a supported exchange pair

functions.name: exchange_currency
functions.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another using real-time exchange rates. Returns the converted amount, exchange rate, and timestamp of the conversion. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

tocurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the target currency (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Must be uppercase letters.

fromcurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the source currency (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Must be uppercase letters.

amount.description: Numeric value to convert, provided as a string to maintain precision (e.g., '150.25').

functions.name: convert_single_phase_power_watts_to_current_ampheres
functions.description: Converts single-phase electrical power in watts to current in amperes using voltage and power factor. Useful for calculating current draw in AC circuits when power consumption, voltage, and power factor are known. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

power.description: Real power in watts (W). Must be a positive numeric value representing the active power consumed by the load.

powerfactor.description: Power factor of the electrical system as a decimal value between 0 and 1. Defaults to 0.95 for typical residential loads.

voltage.description: Electrical supply voltage in volts (V). Defaults to 230V for standard single-phase residential power in many regions.
